modification_description: The boundaries and transparency plan must be operationalized with concrete, measurable behaviors (e.g., defining what 'close friendship' means in practice regarding frequency of one-on-one time and types of messages), a clear transparency protocol that reduces uncertainty without requiring full disclosure of every detail, scheduled check-ins (e.g., every 30–60 days) to reassess emotional safety, specified consequences if boundaries are crossed (e.g., mandatory renegotiation, and if repeated, treating it as a trust issue), and protections for the dignity of all parties so boundaries serve couple emotional safety rather than control or humiliation.
